text: In February 2025, the Thai government forcibly returned 40 Uyghur men to China, where they could face torture, arbitrary detention and long-term imprisonment - a deportation documented by Human Rights Watch (World Report 2026) and condemned by the UN and governments.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: World Report 2026, Thailand chapter - 'Refugees, Asylum Seekers, and Migrant Workers'
source.quote: On February 27, the Paetongtarn government sent 40 Uyghur men to China, where they could face torture, arbitrary detention, and long-term imprisonment.

additionalSources.name: Amnesty International: State of the World's Human Rights report, Thailand 2025
additionalSources.quote: On 27 February, the authorities deported 40 Uyghurs to China, despite the real risk of serious human rights violations, and the prohibition of refoulement under Thailand's anti-torture law.
